gate0.note: the gate is taken on scope='all' -- the objective's own statement is about the boundary data, and scope='seam' is reported beside it because it is what one seam's control can actually reach. The verdict is recorded PER COLUMN: 'passes' is the literal form of the gate (every row) and 'passes_admissible' is the exposed column alone, which is the configuration L2/R10 admits.
